Hi Sarah / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get procurement moving without surprises: 

- Commercial path: during the call you mentioned preference for a PO-based purchase via your central procurement (vs corporate card). Confirming — is the standard path a Purchase Requisition (PR) that converts to a PO through Coupa/Ariba?
- Supplier onboarding: procurement asked about Redwood’s supplier ID / tax docs. I’ve attached our W-9 and a short PR template that procurement teams often use for cloud platform purchases.
- Marketplace: you flagged interest in buying through the AWS Marketplace if that simplifies finance — are you evaluating Marketplace vs direct PO? We can support either, but it changes the billing flow and lead time.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Please confirm the preferred commercial path (PO via Coupa/Ariba vs corporate card vs AWS Marketplace).
2) If PO, share any supplier onboarding form or tell us the supplier ID fields you need (e.g., supplier name, tax id/EIN, bank remit instructions).
3) If helpful, I can loop in our finance ops (Aditya) to help set up supplier record in Coupa/Ariba or provide any internal ticketing info they need.

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few quick answers from procurement: 
- We prefer a PO (PR -> PO) through Coupa. That’s the standard for platform/vendor spend.
- We need Redwood’s supplier name, EIN, and a contact for invoicing. We also need a W-9 on file — thanks for attaching.
- Marketplace is being evaluated by our cloud team but won’t be the default for Q2 purchases due to discounting and terms.

Next from our side: I’ll open the PR and need the supplier name exactly as it appears on your W-9 plus a Redwood contact for statements/invoice handling. If you can provide those fields, I’ll link the PR to your supplier record. Also, if you have an existing Coupa supplier ID for Redwood (from past customers), include that — otherwise we need to onboard a new supplier.

I’ll aim to have the PR created by end of week once I have the details.

Thanks,
